name: Time zone converter
summary: Convert a time between time zones
author: friday-core
description: Converts a clock time between time zones using the daylight-saving rules of the date you give (today if none): 3pm IST in New York and London. Understands IANA names (Asia/Kolkata) and common names and abbreviations (IST, PST, EST, CET, JST, Dubai, Singapore, Sydney). Ambiguous abbreviations (CST, BST, IST) state which meaning was used.
